name: collabed
description: Estimate creator rates, review brand deal offers, and manage your Collabed brand deals and deadlines.

interface.longDescription: Estimate UGC and influencer rates and review brand offers before you commit. Collabed helps creators understand deal terms, compare fees with typical rates, and keep brand partnerships organized. Connect your Collabed account to see your deals, track upcoming deadlines, save new deals with their deliverables, and update a deal's status or payment status. Rate estimates and offer reviews work without an account; your own deals and any change to them require connecting your Collabed account.
defaultPrompt: Estimate a typical USD rate for a 30-second TikTok video with 25,000 followers.
Review this brand deal email and flag terms I should get in writing.
Show my upcoming brand deal deadlines in Collabed.
